title: 破浪归航
prompt: Original instrumental action-strategy game score, 90 seconds, historical Chinese coastal battle. Resolute disciplined energy, coordinated soldiers crossing the sea to break a fortress, heroic but not bombastic. Pipa rhythmic figures, low bowed strings, Chinese war drums in steady measured patterns, sheng and dizi melody, sparse bronze percussion. 112 BPM with a memorable pentatonic theme and alternating dense and open phrases. Controlled low end, warm midrange, little piercing high-frequency energy, leave space for cannons and commands. Build toward a brief hopeful cadence and a clean musical resolution. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no electric guitars, no EDM, no modern snare rolls, no wall of trailer impacts.
